messages:
Alice M: Heads up — Acme (AE @Ben K) just escalated an ask: official Python + JS SDKs for Marketplace publishing + SSO/SCIM hooks + a Terraform provisioning module. They say shipping this by end of Q3 unlocks ~$140k ARR. What's our triage?
Ben K: Confirmed, deal-side is blocked until we can commit to an ETA and basic acceptance criteria. They've asked for a partner-ready Marketplace package and SSO provisioning guide.
Carla P: Okay — need to scope. Quick Qs: does 'Marketplace' mean a package we can publish to AWS/GCP marketplaces or just a listing + billing integration? Also are we doing full SCIM user/group sync or a minimal SCIM create/update/delete?
Ben K: They want publishable artifacts (package + marketplace listing) and SCIM sync for users & groups. Terraform used by their infra team to provision API credentials and attach entitlements.
Dmitri R: Technical notes: we have a Marketplace listing flow for hosted models but no packaged SDK releases that include CLI + upload tooling. SCIM endpoints exist in a limited form (dedicated customers) but not as a hardened public-contract. Terraform provider currently community-maintained — not officially supported.
Eva L: From DevEx POV, recommended minimum: (1) SDKs shipping with v1.0 stable methods for auth + publish + model metadata, (2) examples for Marketplace publishing + CI/CD snippet, (3) SCIM client with group sync example, (4) Terraform module that wraps the API for credential and route provisioning.
Carla P: Proposal: Two-phase delivery to balance risk and sales timeline. Phase A (shipable in ~6w): official Python + JS SDKs (publish to PyPI/npm), Marketplace client primitives, docs + examples, SCIM lite (create/update user + group sync, no delta optimization), and sample Terraform module as example (not GA). Phase B (next 6-8w): Harden SCIM (rate limits, bulk), full Terraform provider GA, marketplace billing callbacks, SLA docs.
Dmitri R: Sounds reasonable. Phase A estimate: 3 engineers x 4 weeks (including QA/docs). Phase B will need infra work for billing callbacks and security review.
Ben K: Sales asks to mark this high priority. If we can promise Phase A by end of Q3 they're willing to push contract.
Carla P: Acceptance criteria for Phase A (please validate):
- Official SDK releases (PyPI + npm) with documented public surface for auth, publish, list, and fetch.
- Marketplace sample that demonstrates creating listing metadata and CI publish pipeline.
- SCIM endpoints supported for user create/update/delete + group mapping documented and example client in SDK.
- Terraform example module that provisions an API key and configures routing to a model endpoint (example only).
- Basic e2e test in repo and quickstart docs.
Dmitri R: Agreed, adding: security review signoff + automated tests for SCIM flows.
triage-bot: Tagging request -> integration:sdk, request-source:sales, priority:high, domain:marketplace, domain:ssoscim, backlog:needs-triage
Carla P: Assigning owner: Carla P (PM). Owner to create RFC + checklist (RFC due by 1799990020) and estimate card in backlog. Proposal: move Phase A into sprint 34, Phase B candidate for sprint 36 depending on capacity.
Alice M: FYI @Ben K, I'll add contract note that given this is a high-priority sales ask the customer expects weekly sync until Phase A delivery.
Eva L: DevEx will draft SDK design doc and examples. Suggest 1 public API surface per language:
```
# example python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
# publish metadata
c.marketplace.publish(name="acme-connector", version="0.1.0", files=["dist/wheel.whl"]) 
# scim user create
c.scim.create_user({"userName": "jane.doe@acme.com", "name": {"givenName": "Jane", "familyName": "Doe"}})
```
Carla P: Next steps: (1) I will open RFC and backlog card with Phase A scope and acceptance criteria (by 1799990020). (2) Eng-platform (Dmitri) to confirm feasibility and update estimates by 1799990035. (3) DevEx (Eva) to produce SDK surface & examples draft by 1799990045. (4) Triage-bot will place tags and a reminder.
Dmitri R: Will do. If any of the security gating items move to critical we'll need to re-evaluate timeline.
Ben K: :thumbsup: I'll update the AE and legal with the plan and tie milestone to contract terms.
Carla P: Thanks everyone — moving this to backlog as 'integration-request/sdk-marketplace-ssoscim' and pinging eng-platform for intake meeting tomorrow.
triage-bot: Backlog update -> moved to product backlog (card: PROJ-4127), tags applied.
